meaning: Open-ended exploration without a pre-chosen target shape (per the R-layer spec convention) -- registered here, not investigated, per review instruction (PR-R2.6, AUDIT.md Sec.18): do not discard.
why_these_cases: PR-R2.5 (AUDIT.md Sec.17) classified 172 non-verified direct neighbors of verified nodes (that are independently confirmed self-sustaining once disconnected from the verified set, PR-R2.4 Sec.16.2) by their CONNECTED-state waveform. 48 of the 172 show irregular, aperiodic, large-amplitude motion (no autocorrelation peak found within the expressible window) -- neither the clean, verified-classification-eligible oscillation the R-layer's R3/R4/R7 pipeline targets, nor a settled/decaying/fixed-point trajectory. Per review: clean oscillators and this frustrated population are the two ends of an order/disorder spectrum; the middle ground between them has not been measured by any instrument in this codebase. Not pursued in PR-R2.6 -- registered for a future PR.
